benchmark_type_evidence: We present the IndicNLG Benchmark, a collection of datasets for benchmarking NLG for 11 Indic languages. We focus on five diverse tasks... Our dataset creation methods can be easily applied to modest-resource languages as they involve simple steps such as scraping news articles and Wikipedia infoboxes, light cleaning, and pivoting through machine translation data.
brief_description: IndicNLG Benchmark is a collection of datasets for benchmarking NLG performance across 5 diverse tasks (biography generation, headline generation, sentence summarization, paraphrase generation, question generation) spanning 11 Indic languages, comprising approximately 8.5M examples total. It is the first NLG benchmark for Indic languages.
